description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This leadership role offers a vital opportunity to contribute to exceptional patient care and support our nursing team in a dynamic environment. We are looking for a compassionate and skilled professional ready to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents.

This position comes with a competitive annual salary ranging from $60,000 to $75,000, reflecting your experience and qualifications. We highly prefer candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) to ensure the highest standard of clinical leadership and patient oversight. Join a team committed to excellence and professional growth.
requirements: Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Ability to supervise and mentor nursing staff
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are actively seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the quality of patient care and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are actively interviewing candidates and encourage prompt applications.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and implementing best practices to achieve exceptional patient outcomes. You will play a crucial role in staff development, quality improvement initiatives, and maintaining a high standard of care.

This is an urgent opening for a leader passionate about making a significant impact in a skilled nursing environment. Join a team committed to excellence and providing compassionate care to our residents.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility.
Demonstrated leadership abilities with a strong focus on clinical excellence and team development.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $105,000, based on experience.

description: Join a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL, as a PRN Occupational Therapist. This facility, with 55-59 beds and a current census of 43, offers a vibrant and supportive environment for both patients and staff. Located on a main street with abundant shopping nearby and a pleasant neighborhood behind the building, you'll find convenience and charm.Enjoy the flexibility of PRN shifts while making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being. The center boasts two courtyards, providing a serene setting, and is just 15 minutes from the beach, allowing for an excellent work-life balance in a desirable Florida location. We are seeking a dedicated Occupational Therapist to provide high-quality, individualized therapy services to our residents.
requirements: Valid Occupational Therapist (OT) license in the state of Florida.
Master's or Doctorate degree in Occupational Therapy from an accredited program.
Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or rehabilitation setting is preferred.
Ability to work PRN shifts as needed.
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $55.00 - $60.00, based on experience.
